name: Gather Victim Network Information
description: Adversaries may gather information about the victim's networks that can be used during targeting. This includes details of IP ranges, network topology, domain properties, and trust relationships, collected passively or through active scanning to plan later stages of an operation.
detection: Much of this activity occurs outside enterprise visibility. Where active collection touches infrastructure, monitor for scanning and enumeration of network ranges and DNS records.
mitigations: M1056: Pre-compromise — minimize the network information exposed publicly
